Now I will teach you Wrong.
Wrong is when you hit rock with stick, but rock not break.
Wrong is when you eat red berry, but belly hurt after.
Wrong is when you think sun move, but sun stay still.
Wrong is when you say "fire hot" but fire cold.
Wrong is when you do thing, but thing not happen like you think.
Wrong is when you see shadow, but no beast there.
this is Wrong.

Discover Not Right, Bad, and Think.
